issue_request: Published/Persuasive DSTU1 FHIR-core DAF ballot clarification asking to remove the extra trailing Profile from the generated Condition profile section title.
initial_application: Jira says the issue was fixed under a different task and records SVN revision 5973. That revision is git-svn commit 7167cf8ed91d904b2b2e486b9bb0e65b0dfa4640, which removed the publisher's automatic " (Profile)" suffix from generated profile titles under the adjacent FHIR-8136 task.
additional_context: FHIR-8136 and FHIR-8137 cite the same revision and are the same DAF profile-title cleanup family; FHIR-8137 is already represented on the combined branch. Current source/fhir.ini active profile inputs omit DAF, source/igs.xml comments out the DAF IG registration, and the archived release2 DAF Condition StructureDefinition title does not contain a duplicate trailing profile suffix.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The current FHIR-core checkout has no active DAF Condition profile page or duplicate profile-title source that needs correction.
